digest.component_or_area: LLM provider framework and model resolution
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs OpenAI model targets using the bare `openai:` prefix, warning that v2 will reinterpret it as Responses instead of Chat Completions
Model target resolution in anthropic_model.py and model_classes.py composes and returns ambiguous `openai:` qualifiers for inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets

ProviderSession custom-endpoint builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override guards match only the legacy provider name `openai`, so explicit `openai-chat:` targets fail to route through configured loopback endpoints
Normalizing all rebar-owned OpenAI target construction to explicit `openai-chat:` prefix resolves the deprecation warning while preserving Chat Completions wire semantics and custom-endpoint routing

Provider-session and model-class resolution must treat `openai` and `openai-chat` as compatible spellings to maintain backward compatibility and unified conflict detection across configured and inline targets
